desc: Compute an invoice total in cents, using integer arithmetic only. Steps, in order: (1) if any line has qty below 1, return the error "bad quantity: " followed by the sku of the first such line. (2) Each line's amount is qty * unit_cents; if qty is 10 or more, subtract a bulk discount of amount / 10 rounded down. (3) The subtotal is the sum of the line amounts. (4) Apply the coupon to the subtotal: "" means no coupon; "SAVE500" subtracts 500, but the result never goes below 0; "PCT10" subtracts subtotal / 10 rounded down; "BIG20" subtracts subtotal / 5 rounded down, but only if the subtotal is at least 10000, otherwise return the error "coupon not applicable: BIG20"; any other coupon string (codes are case-sensitive) returns the error "unknown coupon: " followed by the coupon. (5) Add 8% tax on the amount after the coupon, rounded to the nearest cent with halves rounded up, i.e. tax = (amount * 8 + 50) / 100 with the division rounded down. Return amount plus tax. An empty invoice totals 0.

decls.ts:
type Line = { sku: string; qty: number; unit_cents: number };
type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
